services.name: Patron Program
services.desc: Patrons’ support is at the heart of our ability to sustain the MFA’s mission and expand its impact. Patrons provide essential unrestricted funding for the Museum by contributing nearly ten percent of the MFA’s annual budget. Patron support underwrites key exhibitions and programs that bring people and art together in a way that both opens eyes and lives. Join us today to experience the power of your philanthropic leadership at work! The MFA invites you to sample the Patron experience through invitations to a select group of events and programs designed to bring you closer to the core of the MFA, its collections, and staff. services.name: School Programs
services.desc: The MFA’s K-12 programs activate the Museum’s global art collection, inspiring creativity and learning through school group visits, distance learning, educator professional development, and digital resources. Inspire students, connect to your curriculum, and engage with exceptional works of art in person through a visit to the MFA. Guided and self-guided visits are available for PreK-12 audiences. Bring the MFA into your classroom with live, interactive distance learning programs direct from the Museum’s galleries.
